title: Wing Trailing Edge Harnesses — Flap Position Sensing and Track Area Runs
abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the wing trailing edge harnesses, showing the flap position sensing runs, the track area clip stations and the drip loops that keep moisture out of the connectors.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wing trailing edge harnesses serving the flap position sensing circuits and the track area, together with the clip stations and the drip loop positions.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn for the left wing looking aft; the right wing is a mirror image with the same harness references. The sensing circuits are duplicated and are routed in separate looms on opposite sides of the rib so that a single mechanical event cannot take both channels. Clip stations in the track area are shown with their tolerance because the harness must remain clear of the carriage roller envelope at full flap extension, which is drawn dashed on sheet 2.
sections.routing_note: The harness leaves the wing junction at the rear spar, runs outboard along the trailing edge in zones 525 and 624, and drops down to the flap track areas in zones 562 and 662. Drip loops are formed immediately before each connector so that water running along the harness cannot enter the contact. Minimum clearance from the carriage roller envelope at full extension is 40 millimetres; any change to the roller or the track profile requires this clearance to be re-checked. Bracket stations 5120W-B3 and 5121W-B5 carry the harness where it crosses the flap support rib. A bracket station moved by structural work must be re-supported and not re-clipped to the nearest surviving station, but no re-support scheme is published for either of these two positions.

title: Wing Trailing Edge Harnesses — Flap Position Sensing and Track Area Runs

issue.reason: A re-support scheme is published on a new sheet for the two rib bracket stations that the revised attachment pattern displaces.

abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the wing trailing edge harnesses, showing the flap position sensing runs, the track area clip stations, the drip loops, and the re-support scheme for the two bracket stations that cross the flap support rib.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wing trailing edge harnesses serving the flap position sensing circuits and the track area, together with the clip stations and the drip loop positions.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn for the left wing looking aft; the right wing is a mirror image with the same harness references. Clip stations in the track area are shown with their tolerance because the harness must remain clear of the carriage roller envelope at full flap extension, which is drawn dashed on sheet 2. Sheet 3 carries the re-support scheme for the two bracket stations that cross the flap support rib.
sections.routing_note: The harness leaves the wing junction at the rear spar, runs outboard along the trailing edge in zones 525 and 624, and drops down to the flap track areas in zones 562 and 662.
